title: Split Table (Tables)

scenarios.title: Split Table applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Split Table (BtnTableSplit) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnTableSplit deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Split Table command applied to a fixture 3x3 table with the cell in column 3 selected splits the table at that column: the original table is replaced by two tables side by side (20 pt gap, the second starting at the first's right edge), the first keeps the original columns 1-2 and the second the original column 3 with their texts, the feature reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Split Table command applied to a fixture 3x3 table with the cell in column 3 selected splits the table at that column: the original table is replaced by two tables side by side (20 pt gap, the second starting at the first's right edge), the first keeps the original columns 1-2 and the second the original column 3 with their texts, the feature reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
